title: What's Cooking in Business Central: Financial Reporting Enhancements (part 2): Telemetry

chapters.title: Demo: Creating and Editing Financial Reports

features.name: Financial Report Creation Telemetry
features.description: Telemetry events that track when financial reports are created, capturing the report definition code and timestamp in Application Insights.

features.name: Row Definition Telemetry
features.description: Telemetry events that capture the creation and modification of row definitions for financial reports, including the definition code in custom dimensions.

features.name: Column Definition Telemetry
features.description: Telemetry events that track the creation and modification of column definitions for financial reports, with the column definition code logged.

features.name: Financial Report Modification Telemetry
features.description: Telemetry events for tracking modifications to financial reports, row definitions, and column definitions, including deletion events.
caveats: Not demonstrated in the video but mentioned as capability

features.name: Financial Report Usage Telemetry
features.description: Telemetry events that capture when financial reports are executed and run, providing usage analytics.
caveats: Not demonstrated in the video but mentioned as capability
